title: 9 Questions Only 1% Finish Perfect
hook: Are you smarter than most people?
script:
Are you smarter than most people?
Question 1: Who was the first emperor of the Roman Empire?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Augustus.
Question 2: In which epic fantasy film series does the character Frodo Baggins appear?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: The Lord of the Rings.
Question 3: Which European city is famously known as the 'Eternal City'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Rome.
If you got the first three right, like the video right now.
Question 4: In what year did the RMS Titanic sink on its maiden voyage?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: 1912.
Question 5: Who directed the critically acclaimed 1997 film 'Titanic'?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: James Cameron.
Score check: comment SHARP if you are still perfect, RUSTY if you already missed one.
Question 6: Which river is generally considered the longest in the world?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is C: Nile River.
Question 7: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Mercury.
Are you ready for the last question?
Don't forget to follow and comment your score to be on the weekly leaderboard of the top performers.
Question 8: Which film won the first Best Animated Feature Oscar?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is B: Shrek.
Question 9: Which letter is missing from all US state names?
Lock in your answer: Three. Two. One.
The answer is A: Q.
Bonus: double or nothing - keep your score in your head and beat it on the next quiz.
Comment your score out of 9, and follow for a new quiz every day.

items.question: Who was the first emperor of the Roman Empire?
items.explanation: Augustus, born Octavian, was adopted by his great-uncle Julius Caesar and became the first Roman emperor.

items.question: In which epic fantasy film series does the character Frodo Baggins appear?
items.explanation: Frodo Baggins is the central protagonist in J.R.R. Tolkien's 'The Lord of the Rings'.

items.question: Which European city is famously known as the 'Eternal City'?
items.explanation: Rome earned the nickname 'Eternal City' due to its enduring history and significance.

items.question: In what year did the RMS Titanic sink on its maiden voyage?
items.explanation: The Titanic sank on April 15, 1912, after striking an iceberg in the North Atlantic.

items.question: Who directed the critically acclaimed 1997 film 'Titanic'?
items.explanation: James Cameron wrote, directed, and produced the blockbuster film 'Titanic'.

items.question: Which river is generally considered the longest in the world?
items.explanation: The Nile River flows for approximately 6,650 kilometers (4,132 miles) through northeastern Africa.

items.question: Which metal is liquid at room temperature?
items.explanation: Mercury stays liquid even below zero.

items.question: Which film won the first Best Animated Feature Oscar?
Which letter is missing from all US state names?
items.explanation: No state name contains the letter Q.
